keyword: is justin bieber performing at coachella
claims: Justin Bieber headlined Saturday night (April 11 and 18) at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival.
Justin Bieber performed a 90-minute set on the main stage.
Justin Bieber's set featured surprise guests Wizkid, Tems, and The Kid LAROI.
Some critics noted that Bieber used YouTube to play some of his older songs during the set.
Justin Bieber's set featured a unique, minimalist stage design.
Justin Bieber headlined the 2026 festival alongside Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G.
